quota_name: Applications associated per account per region
description: The maximum number of applications associated with an AWS account in a single region

quota_name: Associated alarms per deployment group
description: The maximum number of alarms associated with a deployment group

quota_name: Auto Scaling groups in a deployment group
description: Maximum number of Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling groups in a deployment group

quota_name: AWS Lambda deployment run in hours
description: Maximum number of hours an AWS Lambda deployment can run (48 hours for the maximum time between the first and last traffic shift plus one hour for each of two possible lifecycle hooks)

quota_name: Concurrent deployments per account
description: Maximum number of concurrent deployments associated with an AWS account. Each deployment to a scaled-up Amazon EC2 instance in an Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling group counts as a single concurrent deployment for each application that the EC2 instance is associated with.

quota_name: Concurrent deployments per deployment group
description: Maximum number of concurrent deployments to a deployment group. This limit prevents concurrent deployments of the same application to the same deployment group.

quota_name: Custom deployment configurations per account
description: Maximum number of custom deployment configurations associated with an AWS account

quota_name: Deployment groups associated with a single application
description: Maximum number of deployment groups associated with a single application

quota_name: EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment run in hours
description: Maximum number of hours an EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment can run (48 hours for each of the above two limits plus one hour for each of 13 possible lifecycle events)

quota_name: EC2/On-Premises in-place deployment run in hours
description: Maximum number of hours an EC2/On-Premises in-place deployment can run

quota_name: Event notification triggers in a deployment group
description: Maximum number of event notification triggers in a deployment group

quota_name: GitHub connection tokens per account
description: Maximum number of GitHub connection tokens for a single AWS account

quota_name: Hours between the completion of a deployment and the termination of the original instances during an EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment
description: Maximum number of hours between the completion of a deployment and the termination of the original instances during an EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment

quota_name: Hours between the deployment of a revision and when traffic shifts to the replacement instances during an EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment
description: Maximum number of hours between the deployment of a revision and when traffic shifts to the replacement instances during an EC2/On-Premises blue/green deployment

quota_name: Instances count per deployment
description: Maximum number of instances in a single deployment

quota_name: Minutes a blue/green deployment can wait after a successful deployment before terminating instances from the original deployment
description: Maximum number of minutes a blue/green deployment can wait after a successful deployment before terminating instances from the original deployment

quota_name: Minutes between the first and last traffic shift during an AWS Lambda canary or linear deployment
description: Maximum number of minutes between the first and last traffic shift during an AWS Lambda canary or linear deployment

quota_name: Minutes until a deployment fails if a lifecycle event doesn't start
description: Maximum number of minutes until a deployment fails if a lifecycle event doesn't start after (1) a deployment is triggered by using the console or the AWS CLI create-deployment command, or (2) the previous lifecycle event is completed.

quota_name: Number of deployment groups that can be associated with an Amazon ECS service
description: Maximum number of deployment groups that can be associated with an Amazon ECS service

quota_name: Number of instances that can be passed to the BatchGetOnPremisesInstances API action
description: Maximum number of instances that can be passed to the BatchGetOnPremisesInstances API action

quota_name: Number of instances used by concurrent deployments that are in progress per account
description: Maximum number of instances that can be used by concurrent deployments that are in progress and associated with one account

quota_name: Number of listeners for a traffic route during an Amazon ECS deployment
description: Maximum number of listeners for a traffic route during an Amazon ECS deployment

quota_name: Seconds until a deployment lifecycle event fails if not completed
description: Maximum number of seconds until a deployment lifecycle event fails if not completed

quota_name: Size of deployment group name
description: Maximum number of characters in a deployment group name

quota_name: Size of tag key
description: Maximum number of characters in a tag key

quota_name: Size of tag value
description: Maximum number of characters in a tag value

quota_name: Tags in a deployment group
description: Maximum number of tags in a deployment group

quota_name: Traffic that can be shifted in one increment during an AWS Lambda deployment
description: Maximum percentage of traffic that can be shifted in one increment during an AWS Lambda deployment
